clips.title: The story
paras: At Bloodhoof Village, Baine Bloodhoof fears the dwarves' digging will anger Mulgore's beasts and scar its sacred earth. He asks young Horde defenders to break the prospectors' picks and halt their work.

Northwest of Bloodhoof Village, dwarven prospectors have marked out a dig site in Mulgore's hills. The Explorer's League searches Kalimdor for titan relics and secrets of the earthen, often without regard for the lands or customs of those who live there. To the tauren, the earth is a living mother, worthy of reverence rather than excavation for stone and metal.

Baine Bloodhoof sees the dwarves' machines and blasting as a threat to the plains' fragile balance. Their noise agitates the local wildlife and stirs the kodos into frenzy. The tauren mean to smash the prospectors' picks at the forges, sending a blunt warning and stopping the digging before it causes lasting harm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest. They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings.
Collect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools.
You can smash the tools at a forge. You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. Do you have the Broken Tools? The dwarves' digging will enrage the kodos of Mulgore. This defilement must be stopped!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. This will calm the beasts of Mulgore. And, spirits willing, it will teach the dwarves that hollowing the land is not the path to knowledge.
